title: Multimodal AI Integration
description: Integrate vision, audio, and multimodal models in .NET applications.

data.text: Multimodal models process images, audio, and text together. Integrate GPT-4 Vision, Whisper for audio, and build multimodal applications.

data.title: Vision Model Integration

points: GPT-4 Vision processes images and text

data.takeaway: Multimodal AI enables rich applications. Integrate vision and audio models to process images, audio, and text together.
